Episodes.description: Charlie Brown wants more attention from Snoopy; Sally’s class pet makes Snoopy jealous; and Lucy believes musicals cause nothing but trouble.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness is the Gift of Giving
Episodes.description: Snoopy adapts a Christmas poem to help Sally sleep; Charlie Brown makes gifts for his pals; and Snoopy can’t wait to open his presents.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness Is a Day at the Beach
Episodes.description: Snoopy and Woodstock search for pirate treasure; the Flying Ace steals Sally’s map; and Snoopy’s expired dog license presents opportunities.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness Is a Hug That Lasts
Episodes.description: Secret Agent Snoopy looks for Charlie Brown; the Beagle Scouts come to Woodstock’s aid; and a hug from Snoopy goes into overtime.
Snoopy and Marcie help Peppermint Patty with her report; Rerun mistakes Snoopy for a leprechaun; and Marcie’s quiet spot is discovered.
Lucy gives Snoopy a test; Spike and Snoopy forget to agree where to meet up; and Snoopy turns the tables on rejection letters.
Snoopy quits the baseball team; Peppermint Patty feels left out of Marcie and Snoopy’s playdate; and Snoopy fears a falling moon.

Episodes.item_title: Who Put the Beagle In Charge?
Episodes.description: Linus wants to thwart Snoopy’s blanket-stealing ways; Charlie Brown finally hits a home run; and Woodstock sends Snoopy a bill for a wild party.

BannerData.item_description: Outspoken and perpetually curious. That’s 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she’ll need to know everything. And to know everything means she’ll need to spy…on everyone.

Episodes.description: Janie and Harriet get to meet their favorite singer, only to discover a shocking truth about his music.
Harriet really wants to win a photo competition, but it means teaming up with someone she doesn’t see eye to eye with: her mom.
Sport and Harriet think it’s time to get rid of their beloved stuffies, but change their minds—and the narrative—thanks to Marion’s sneaky reporting.
Harriet adds the Garcia family to her spy route…and discovers that someone is spying on her.
On her birthday, Ole Golly revisits a list of everything she wanted to do by the age of 35—and Harriet is determined to help her complete it.
When Harriet loses her last—and favorite—baby tooth, she struggles with saying goodbye to her babyhood.

Episodes.item_title: It’s My Party and I’ll Spy If I Want To
Episodes.description: The Welsch family attends a neighborhood party where Harriet is determined to find out why the Robinsons are so boring.
At the world’s fair, Harriet meets a 14-year-old photographer who’s unsure of his future—but shows Harriet how to cherish today.
Sport joins Harriet for a local scavenger hunt. But when he brings his good-luck charm to improve their chances, Harriet is skeptical.
While Harriet’s parents are out, she and Ole Golly join Mr. Waldenstein for a movie date. But can they get home before Harriet’s parents do?
When Ole Golly announces she and Mr. Waldenstein are getting married and moving to Montreal, Harriet tries to change her mind.

BannerData.item_description: Budding environmentalist Jane is a 9-year-old on a quest to save endangered animals. Using her powerful imagination, Jane takes her best friends David and Greybeard the chimpanzee on epic adventures to help protect wild animals all around the world.

Episodes.description: Jane, David, and Greybeard must reunite a lost baby panda with its mother—and find out why they’re the only bears with six fingers.
Tracking a wolf in the snowy mountains leads the trio to their neighbor’s pug, who helps connect the dots between wolves, dogs, and people.
The three friends use their underground vessel to observe the elusive pink fairy armadillo, but a garden problem stops them in their tracks.
While exploring the Great Barrier Reef to determine if coral is a plant or an animal, the trio learn that looks can be deceiving.
With David sick in bed, Jane must partner with an unexpected ally to save Greybeard from a pride of lions.
Jane, David, and Greybeard set off to find out why hippos give birth away from their pods, while trying to reunite a baby hippo with her mom.
The trio head underground to dig into wombat defense tactics. Jane wants the community BBQ menu to explore new options.
David joins Jane on a high-flying mission to chart an albatross’ journey instead of helping his sister Millie.
Jane convinces her reluctant abuela to help get a baby elephant back to his family, where she uncovers why herds follow a matriarch.
Jane and Greybeard lose hope when they see how humans impact chimpanzees in the wild, but David and a special friend restore her faith.

BannerData.item_description: On a charming island, Square, Triangle, and Circle seek adventure and connection while learning how to navigate each other’s differences. Based on the internationally best-selling books by Mac Barnett and Jon Klassen.

Episodes.item_title: Triangle Goes Solo / Circle Makes a Mistake
Episodes.description: The fearless Triangle sets out on his own. Circle leads a journey to ancient ruins and unexpectedly runs into trouble.
A change of plans tests Square’s patience. Circle helps Square start a garden, but she struggles with his instant success.

Episodes.item_title: Triangle and Square’s Big Game / The Shooting Star
Episodes.description: When Circle brushes off their game, Triangle and Square feel insecure. A mysterious meteor crash inspires a trek across the island.
After Triangle pranks them, Circle and Square celebrate Halloween on their own with all treats and no tricks.
The chilly season leaves Square feeling sad, so Circle and Triangle try to cheer him up by creating a new holiday: Yeti Night.

Episodes.item_title: Narrator’s Big Day / Square’s Time Chest
Episodes.description: The Shapes’ rather ordinary day gives Narrator time to herself. Square struggles to find the perfect object for his time capsule.
Square feels guilty after trading away a gift from Circle. Square and Circle try to find the source of Triangle’s allergies.

Episodes.item_title: Square’s Missing Mug / Triangle Stands Still
Episodes.description: The disappearance of Square’s favorite mug sends him on an island-wide hunt. Triangle bets Circle that he can meditate for 10 minutes.
Circle wakes up to a surprise—and suddenly needs a place to stay. A new visitor to the island creates quite a stir.

Episodes.item_title: From Top to Bottom / Circle’s Equal
Episodes.description: Circle, Square, and Triangle face off in a wild race for a tasty prize. Circle is thrilled to finally meet a Shape like her.
Triangle and Square follow a mysterious map, hoping to find treasure. Circle’s hat design inspires her to make bigger, better creations.

sub_category_data.sub_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock

BannerData.item_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
BannerData.item_description: Jim Henson’s fun-loving, musical Fraggles are back! Join Gobo, Red, Wembley, Mokey, Boober, and new Fraggle friends on hilarious, epic adventures about the magic that happens when we celebrate and care for our interconnected world.

Episodes.description: Fast-talking Doozer Jack Hammer picks Wembley as the spokesfraggle for the new (terrible) Doozer sticks. Wembley finds himself at a crossroads.
Red finds the pond is too full of goo to dive, so she tries zip-vining and hurts her baloobius. Mokey tries to help Red find a new outlet for her energy.
When Marjory falls ill, Boober is called to a special task: venture into the deep mountain of trash in order to heal her.
To bring water back to Fraggle Rock and set things right, Gobo convinces the gang to work with an unlikely ally.
Fraggle Rock is all aglow as a festive celebration with friends kicks off. Uncle Matt explores the holiday traditions of Silly Creatures.
Mysterious wind sends Gobo on a quest to find the source. Pa Gorg forbids Junior from seeing the Fraggles. Doc experiments with wind power.
The gusties throw Red off course. Gobo gives Junior one of Uncle Matt’s artifacts. Sprocket adjusts to Doc’s new schedule.
Mokey’s recent discovery occupies all her time and attention. When Doc gets distracted, Sprocket comes to her aid.
Boober’s Radish Razzle event gets disrupted by a divided Fraggle Rock. Doc’s self-talk takes a step in a kinder direction.
Wembley experiments with self-expression. Junior discovers his own path on Boxing Day. Doc allows herself to be more than just one thing.
Gobo’s overexcitement causes him to be dismissive of others. The Gorgs strategize on strawberries. Doc takes Sprocket’s fear to heart.

sub_category_data.sub_title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse

BannerData.item_title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
BannerData.item_description: 2023 Oscar® winner: Best Animated Short Film. Charlie Mackesy’s bestseller comes to life in this beautifully animated film from NoneMore and Bad Robot Productions. Follow the unlikely bond between four friends on their journey to find home.

Going to school and making new friends can be tough. Having to do both while wearing a bulky hearing aid on your chest? That takes superpowers! With a little help from her superhero alter ego, El Deafo, Cece learns to embrace her differences.

Episodes.description: After a sudden illness leaves Cece with hearing loss, her powerful new hearing aid inspires the creation of a superhero alter ego.
Cece finds a true friend in the bubbly and boisterous Martha, but an innocent mishap could break their amazing bond for good.
Cece’s friendship with Martha isn’t the only thing that needs repairing after gym teacher Mr. Potts accidentally breaks Cece’s Phonic Ear.

BannerData.item_description: William Wolfe is no ordinary human boy. Down in the magical spryte realm of the Everything Factory, he’s Wolfboy. And with his new spryte friends, he learns his vivid imagination and limitless creativity have the power to change the world.

Episodes.item_title: Wolfboy Goes Home / Wolfboy Makes a Snowflake
Episodes.description: Xandra and Sprout join Wolfboy on his trip home to see his mother. Wolfboy helps Blip find his confidence.

Episodes.item_title: Grandmother Tells a Story / Grandmother Loses Her Crown
Episodes.description: Wolfboy visits Xandra and Sprout’s home to celebrate Elderspryte Day. Grandmother Figwort’s beloved crown is stolen.

Episodes.item_title: Nobody Started It! / Wolfboy Begins His Training
Episodes.description: Dorm rivalry reaches peak silliness with an all-out prank war. Luxcraft begins training Wolfboy to harness his powers.

Episodes.item_title: We Laugh and Cry / We Don’t Know Who to Trust
Episodes.description: Wolfboy’s secret training leaves him no time to focus on the Laugh Lab assignment. Wolfboy tells his friends the truth about everything.
An intense dream causes Wolfboy to sleepwalk toward a forbidden area, so the gang heads to the Dream Lab for help.

Episodes.item_title: Wolfboy Takes a Ride / Wolfboy Talks With Nyx
Episodes.description: Wolfboy steps through the infamous “passage” and finds himself in the Disarray Realm. Wolfboy finally meets Nyx, and she’s not what he imagined.

Episodes.item_title: Nyx Answers a Question / Wolfboy and Seth Escape
Episodes.description: While honing his destruction powers, Wolfboy meets a young disarray named Seth. Startling discoveries are made during a daring getaway.

Episodes.item_title: A Dinosaur Comes for Tea / Things Seem Unsound
Episodes.description: Xandra and Sprout have a difficult time warming up to Seth. The value of Seth’s skills come to light after a disarray incident in the Sound Lab.

Episodes.item_title: The Color Fades / Wolfboy Frolics With the Enemy
Episodes.description: Vibrant flowers on the surface come under attack from the disarrays. Xandra’s favorite comic series reveals clues to Wolfboy’s prophecy.

Episodes.item_title: The Bubble Is Popped / Xandra Finds a Memory
Episodes.description: The sprytes celebrate their most beloved holiday: Bubble Day! Xandra finds the strength to watch the one memory of her parents she has yet to see.

Episodes.item_title: Wolfboy Takes the Plunge / The Stars Are Restored
Episodes.description: Luxcraft’s decision leaves Wolfboy feeling even more unsure about who to trust. The gang makes a shocking discovery in Luxcraft’s office.

BannerData.item_description: Between her parents’ divorce and best friend moving away, Amber Brown is having a tough time. But her art, video diary, and new friend Brandi provide outlets for Amber to express her feelings and find gratitude in the love that surrounds her.

Episodes.description: Starting middle school without her best friend, Justin, makes Amber all the more grateful for new friend and neighbor Brandi.
Amber and Brandi find a diamond ring, which leads Amber to believe her mom is about to do something Amber’s not quite ready for.
Amber sets aside her fears and auditions for the school play, while her dad moves into a new apartment.
It’s the night of the play and Amber’s nervous. She hopes her dad, who’s stuck in traffic, makes it in time to see her debut.
Amber wants to get her ears pierced—just like Brandi—so she enlists the help of Aunt Pam to try persuading her mom.
As the girls get ready for their first school dance, Amber feels bad about disobeying her mom and wants to come clean.

BannerData.item_description: In this sci-fi anthology series, curiosity leads to chaos when students in the near future experience mysterious events.

Episodes.description: Jacob is desperate to make the school track team and his height is holding him back. Can a medical research lab help him grow faster?
Aspiring dancer Jesse can’t balance his priorities, so a friend builds his robotic duplicate. But things take a turn when Jesse loses control of his double.
After her parents’ divorce, Emily uses a memory therapy device to relive happier times—until an error threatens to erase the past forever.
Carefree student Seth and his strict principal mistakenly swap bodies when a school presentation goes wrong.
When time seemingly freezes, a mismatched group of students get trapped in detention and must work together to find a way out.
Siblings Jack and Cassady buy a new remote for their media room and discover it can control their overbearing parents—for better and worse.

BannerData.item_description: After a life-changing experience, 13-year-old Ella is eager to seize the day. As she learns to appreciate each moment, she faces the fears that once defined her—and encourages others to do the same.

Episodes.description: A clean bill of health means a new beginning for Ella, but going back to school tests her can-do spirit.
As Ella encourages Kai to live in the moment, she attempts to let go of her past with Ximena. Grady discovers a new passion.
Ella searches for swimwear after being invited to a pool party. Grady makes a plan to step out of Ella’s shadow at school.
A flashback offers a glimpse into Ella’s interests—and anxieties—before everything changed. Grady and his dad search for a new shared hobby.
The McCaffreys embark on a spontaneous camping trip. Ximena and Kai put their friendship to the test at an escape room.
Ella gets the chance to meet her favorite pop star and tries to make the most of the opportunity.

BannerData.item_description: From Skydance Animation comes the story of Sam Greenfield, the unluckiest person in the world! Suddenly finding herself in the never-before-seen Land of Luck, she must unite with the magical creatures there to turn her luck around.
Siblings Karl, Addy, and Michael have a very special next-door neighbor: a wise panda named Stillwater. His friendship and stories give them new perspectives on the world, themselves, and each other.

Episodes.description: With Addy home sick, Michael finds it difficult to enjoy a beach trip with Stillwater. A critter causes trouble in Addy and Maya’s garden.
Michael, Molly, and Leo build Jasper a hideout, but he doesn’t seem interested in it. Karl and Koo set off on a daring overnight adventure.
Addy worries her new book club will find her favourite book too childish. Karl spends a day at the beach looking for buried treasure.
Michael gives himself a hard time for missing the game-winning catch. Addy feels left out when she isn’t invited to a birthday dinner.
A bored Karl takes out his frustrations on everyone around him. Michael struggles to finish an art project for an upcoming fair.
Karl and Koo’s competitive games start to ruin their fun. The kids rake Mr. Morgan’s leaves, but a gust of wind undoes their hard work.
Addy wonders how to handle a surprise find in her yard-sale purchase. Michael can’t stop giving Addy “helpful” advice.
Karl gets upset when he reaches the end of his favorite book series. Addy sets an ambitious goal to get to the top of a climbing wall.
Leo deals with stage fright on a project he’s presenting with Michael. Karl envies the attention Emma gets from the cast on her arm.
Addy and her friends unknowingly make Lexi feel left out at a sleepover. Michael’s complaints put a damper on Molly and Leo’s first snowfall.

BannerData.item_description: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures. Based on the award-winning book series by Antoinette Portis.

Episodes.item_title: It’s a Boat / It’s a Mountain
Episodes.description: Powered by imagination, Riley sails away to help a pizza-loving sea creature make friends. Riley invents a mountain in the hopes of kissing a cloud.

Episodes.item_title: It’s an Egg / It’s a Pumpkin
Episodes.description: After a baby dinosaur hatches, Riley uses her imagination to teach it how to play games. Riley gets creative to grow the biggest pumpkin ever.

Episodes.item_title: It’s a Castle / It’s a Plane
Episodes.description: Adventurous Riley embarks on a magical quest to become a knight. Soaring above, Riley tries to keep up with a group of pinky-pink birds.

Episodes.item_title: It’s a Fly-in-the-Sky Balloon / It’s a Piano
Episodes.description: Riley takes flight and imagines surprising ways to cool off Sunny, the sun, on a very hot day. Riley searches for silly sounds to make music.

Episodes.item_title: It’s a Choo-Choo Train / It’s a Treasure Chest
Episodes.description: On a railway adventure, Riley gathers bananas for an unexpected baking project. Riley heads to the beach to collect beloved keepsakes.

Episodes.item_title: It’s a Comet / It’s a Cowboy Hat
Episodes.description: Riley blasts off on a mission to dunk a cookie in a moon river. Cowboy Riley saddles up to chase down a balloon bandit.

BannerData.item_description: Step inside a fantastic land of fun and imagination with Kammy Kam and her beloved friends! Through music and magic, they learn about their world and unlock limitless wonder.

Episodes.description: In a glimmering garden of mirrors, the friends look closer at what makes them unique and celebrate the return of a colorful creature.
After Toodee and Muno make the rain go away, the friends head outdoors to play and cross paths with a purr-fectly playful musician.
A mysterious box unleashes silliness all over GabbaLand, inspiring a visit from King Silly! But is there a time to not be silly?
With Kammy Kam’s help, Brobee faces his first haircut, and a glam expert teaches the crew how to grow, change, and strut in style.
The friends dabble in daydreaming and explore things that make them think—including blooming flowers, bouncing animals, and feelings.
It’s time to let the light in. From sunshine to moonbeams and even flashlights, the Gabba Friends explore it all.
Let’s boogie and do the Thank You Dance! With the help of the magic words “please” and “thank you,” everyone feels appreciated.
There’s no place like home. Toodee pays a visit to Foofa’s colorful, cozy place for a fun-filled day celebrating homes of all shapes and sizes.
Trying something new can be exciting and scary, but the friends are up to the task. They invent a dance, discover a flower, and meet a baby bird.
We all need it, but we don’t always ask for it—help! A day at the beach shows the gang all the ways they count on their friends and help the planet.
Bodies. We all have them, but what do they do? The friends jump and wiggle until their hearts beat faster, then cool down with relaxing yoga.

BannerData.item_description: Welcome to Sagoville, where Harvey loves to play and discover ways to have silly fun! He and his closest friends explore, imagine, and express true thankfulness for all things, big and small, through creative adventures and unforgettable songs.

Episodes.description: An underground train sparks excitement across Sagoville. Rosie and friends help Harvey with a gift for Grandpa Jasper.

Episodes.item_title: A New Boo Boo / Harvey Rocks
Episodes.description: Harvey fills in for everyone’s favorite prankster. After adopting a houseful of pet rocks, Harvey realizes they may be more than he can handle.
Hugbot puzzles everyone with a change in personality. Harvey and Juggo team up to move a giant hot-dog sign.
Jack sets his sights on winning a unique prize at the carnival. While Robin’s loaf of bread naps, the friends learn new ways to play quietly.
Jinja helps Harvey stop his tail from wagging during hide-and-seek. Alan loses his mustache and leans on a cuddly caterpillar for answers.

Episodes.item_title: Baby Harvey / Harvey Makes a Splash
Episodes.description: Robin inspires Harvey to play pretend. Dewey, a darling water droplet, needs help finding a good place to play.

Episodes.item_title: A Little Fun / Toothbrush in Space
Episodes.description: Peanuts offers to shrink Harvey and Jinja for a teeny-tiny party. Larry and Harvey blast off to help Jupiter with a pesky piece of broccoli in his teeth.

Episodes.item_title: Listen to the Shoe / Harvey Comes Undone
Episodes.description: Jack, Harvey, and Binky make music with an unlikely instrument. Harvey’s sweater unravels all over town.

Episodes.item_title: Looking for Acorns / Rainbow Wishing Star
Episodes.description: Robin and Harvey build a stunning snow castle—and accidentally bury Nutmeg’s acorn stash. Harvey and Gary grant wishes around town.

Episodes.item_title: Helping Hands / Leaf It to Harvey and Jinja
Episodes.description: Wilson works hard on a cozy knitting project. Harvey and Jinja invite their friends to a special pool party.

BannerData.item_description: Based on the beloved book series by Arnold Lobel. Frog and Toad are not at all alike. Frog likes new adventures. Toad likes the comforts of home. Yet despite their differences, Frog and Toad are always there for each other—as best friends should be.

Episodes.description: Frog and Toad attempt to fly their homemade kite despite some doubting Robins. Frog handles being lost differently than Toad does.
Toad goes on an epic quest to find a story to tell an unwell Frog. When Toad loses his to-do list, he’s stumped about what to do next.
Toad is excited about his new shoes—until they cause nothing but trouble. Frog aims to rescue Toad’s fancy jacket from a lonely closet.
After a long night’s sleep, Toad realizes Frog’s been busy without him. Frog helps Toad feel OK about plans not going perfectly.
Frog gets sidetracked while running a last-minute errand on Christmas Eve, causing Toad to wonder about where his friend could be.

Episodes.item_title: Frog and Toad and Stick / Spring Cleaning
Episodes.description: Toad feels left out when Frog gives all his attention to his amazing, most perfect stick. Frog helps Toad tidy up.
Toad struggles to find a gift fit for a fancy box. Frog gives Toad the courage to go sledding.
Frog reassures a swimsuit-shy Toad that he doesn’t look funny at all. Frog and Toad secretly plan to surprise each other.
Thoughts of chores piling up make it hard for Toad to relax. Frog’s birthday gift for Toad goes over well except for a “small” issue.
Frog and Toad set off on a search for spring. Toad steps in as a last-minute performer but runs into trouble when he can’t see Frog.
Frog convinces Toad to go camping, but the forest creates quite the disturbance. Frog hopes his spooky story gets a reaction from Toad.

BannerData.item_description: Feathered friends Duck and Goose couldn’t be more different, but in this preschool show, they learn how to bring out the best in one another. Based on books by Tad Hills.

Episodes.description: Duck and Goose get a catchy tune stuck in their heads. When a toy goes missing, they learn they have different approaches to tidying up.
Determined to see their first sunrise, the pals try to stay awake all night. Bluebird’s talent for magic motivates Duck and Goose.

Episodes.item_title: Go Trick or Treating / Three-Legged Race
Episodes.description: A quest for sweets turns spooky when Duck and Goose catch wind of a local “swamp monster.” A race between friends hits an unexpected snag.
Duck and Goose plan for fun in a winter wonderland. The pals work hard to help a lonesome flower bloom in the meadow.
When Thistle gets upset with her new neighbor, Bluebird recalls the bumpy days of Duck and Goose’s early friendship.
Duck encourages Goose to step out of his comfort zone. During a game of hide-and-seek, the friends lose sight of their shadows.
Hoping to cheer up Thistle, Duck and Goose plan a creative surprise. The duo helps a skunk manage her not-so-charming stink clouds.
The friends cross paths with a struggling giant. Duck and Goose attempt to save a teeny-tiny community.
Inspired by an elegant trio, Duck and Goose stage a dance performance. The pals try to uplift Bluebird with songs and treats.
Duck and Goose help Rabbit see a dragonfly up close. Kindness leads to chaos while making snacks.

Episodes.item_title: Thistle’s Quest for the Best / Beaver’s Sticks
Episodes.description: Hoping to find her calling, Thistle practices new skills. Duck and Goose set out to return branches to a crafty beaver.

BannerData.item_description: Join in on feathery fun as Eva seeks adventure in her treetop community. Each night, she learns lessons, reflects through writing, and lends a helping wing wherever she can. Based on the best-selling book series Owl Diaries.

Episodes.item_title: Nest Buddies / Game Night Under the Stars
Episodes.description: On a Hoot Troop trip, Eva works hard to impress Sue. The owlets compete in a series of games and team up to solve a sudden dilemma.

Episodes.item_title: Eva’s Big Catch / Carlos’s Juice Stand
Episodes.description: Grandma leads Humphrey and Eva on a mushroom-catching mission. Eva shakes things up at the local juice stand.
Eva hosts her first sleepover. Lucy’s art making keeps getting interrupted by Eva asking her to help other owlets.
Anxiously awaiting pinecone pizza night, Eva helps her dad work faster. Eva winds up on the front page of the town newspaper.
As Treetopington celebrates a special holiday, Eva helps a lost oriole look for his family—and learns the true meaning of community.

Episodes.item_title: Eva on Ice / Baby Mo’s First Word
Episodes.description: Kiera encourages Eva to learn how to skate, which takes lots of practice and patience. Eva plans a performance to show off Baby Mo’s new trick.
Jacob stays at Eva’s house and opens up about feeling homesick. On a Hoot Troop scavenger hunt, Eva rushes to find all the items herself.
Eva pulls out all the stops to welcome a raccoon to town. After Humphrey shares he’s feeling sad, Eva works hard to cheer him up.
Lucy’s baby sibling starts hatching during Eva’s party. Eva struggles to let Sue take the lead while caring for their cuddly class pet.
For show-and-tell, Dad lets Eva bring his special piece of art—but then disaster strikes. Eva gets nervous before her flute concert.

Episodes.item_title: Eva in the Middle / The Fuzztail Fan
Episodes.description: Jacob and Lucy’s fight weighs on Eva, who sets out to fix their friendship. Eva shows off when her favorite author visits Treetopington.

BannerData.item_description: Little red chicken Piper is a budding writer who uses her big imagination to rewrite stories, jumping into the action to create unforgettable adventures. Based on David Ezra Stein’s best-selling, award-winning children’s book series.

Episodes.item_title: Disco Chickens / Little Red and the Little Red Chicken
Episodes.description: At a disco roller rink, Piper investigates how Grandma and Grandpa met. Piper tries to warn Little Red Riding Hood about the Big Bad Wolf.

Episodes.item_title: Dawn of Wonder Chicken / The Chicken Who Cried Wolf
Episodes.description: Piper transforms into Wonder Chicken to save Chickenopolis. After a shepherd boy cries wolf, Piper helps him find his lost sheep.

Episodes.item_title: Arizona Chickenstone and the Temple of the Troll / The Chicken and the Beanstalk
Episodes.description: As a world explorer, Piper rescues an artifact from a hidden jungle temple. Piper reimagines Jack and the Beanstalk from the Giant’s perspective.
On Halloween, Piper writes a spooky monster story. Piper helps the Sorcerer’s Apprentice use magic to defeat a four-headed dragon.
When Ebenezer Wolf decides to cancel the holidays, Piper teams up with the Three Little Pigs and some ghostly friends to change his mind.

Episodes.item_title: Captain Claw’s Clawsome Quest / Cinderella’s Story
Episodes.description: Piper sets sail with a pirate crew to search for treasure. When a favorite book falls apart, Piper and friends try to piece it back together.

Episodes.item_title: Funky Chicken / Hansel & Gretel and the Chicken
Episodes.description: Papa’s friend shares his passion for hip-hop. Piper rewrites a time-honored tale to make it a little less spooky.

Episodes.item_title: Save the Stalk! / Why Did the Chicken Cross the Road?
Episodes.description: Grandpa encourages Piper to help a struggling storybook character. A friendly lion looks to Piper for guidance on how to be funny.

Episodes.item_title: Mary Had a Little Chicken / The Princess, the Chicken, and the Pea
Episodes.description: Piper puts fun genre twists on a familiar favorite. When a royal athlete can’t fall asleep, Piper leaps into action.

Episodes.item_title: The Magnificent Magician of the Mailbox / Once Upon a Chicken
Episodes.description: Theodore, Duckston, and Piper work together on an illustrated story. Mrs. Slothworth teaches the class about fairy-tale clichés.

Episodes.item_title: The Royal Rollercoaster / Clucky Sinclair and the Three Bears
Episodes.description: Piper and friends help the King build an exciting new ride. Hoping to solve a mystery, Piper transforms into a detective.

BannerData.item_description: Nestled in lavender fields is a lovely little farm where sisters Jill and Jacky nurture and love all their animals—including the talking ones. Being a young farmer isn’t easy, but every day brings adventure and a chance to grow.

Episodes.description: Jacky wants to name her new baby brother, but none of her suggestions work for the family, so she needs big sister Jill’s help.
The golden egg’s gone missing, so Jill, Al, and Pickle search for it. But even with Tucker Pup’s sniffing skills, they’re always one step behind.
As heavy rain pours down, Jill has to rescue her lost sheep and stop her goats from creating a ruckus around the farm.
Jill wants her animals in the new family photo. But getting them to look at the camera—and making sure Jacky stays clean—is hard.
Jill accidentally drops the golden egg, and it starts to hiccup. When she can’t help it stop, Jill wonders if she can be a good farmer.
Jamma’s moving onto the farm and Jill and Jacky want to help—but the golden egg has decided it’s hatching day.
Jill’s excited about the arrival of Darling, a senior donkey. When she tries to help settle him in, Darling seems like he’d rather not be there.
Al and Pickle need a break, so Jill babysits the dragons for them. But she quickly discovers it’s more work than she thought.
Jill is sick in bed, so Jacky takes over barn bedtime duties and finds out the animals would much rather keep playing.
Darling the donkey gets locked inside the barn with the dragon babies and needs to keep them happy until Jill can get them out.
Jacky volunteers to care for Tucker the pup, who has an injured paw, while a stressed Jill takes a calming stroll with Darling.

BannerData.item_description: Embark on adventures with Bigfoot, Unicorn, Sloth, Yak, and Fox as they explore a world of feelings in this Jim Henson Company series that brings the emotional learning of Slumberkins to life.

Episodes.item_title: Yak the Amazing Juggler / Keep On Running
Episodes.description: Yak discovers an exciting talent but feels overshadowed by her new siblings. Fox attempts to hide his tears after getting hurt.

Episodes.item_title: Sunny Day Cupcakes / It’s Great to Be a Bigfoot
Episodes.description: Sloth and Yak enjoy fun in the kitchen until a mishap leads to conflicting emotions. Bigfoot’s self-esteem is tested after he gets teased.

Episodes.item_title: Unicorn’s Box of Great Ideas / Bigfoot’s Family Ukulele
Episodes.description: Bigfoot and Fox accidentally hurt Unicorn’s feelings during a playdate. Bigfoot makes a mistake and learns about unconditional love.

Episodes.item_title: Super Speedy Spin Cone / Special Collection
Episodes.description: Fox struggles when his friends play with a toy he doesn’t have. Sloth loves to give Unicorn gifts but worries it’s the only reason they are friends.

Episodes.item_title: When You Gotta Go / Let’s Go Fix a Kite
Episodes.description: Bigfoot feels anxious over a bathroom emergency. Sloth and Fox have their first big fight and must repair their friendship.

Episodes.item_title: When Things Change / Bigfoot’s First Sleepover
Episodes.description: Fox has a hard time with change when his family moves to a new home. Bigfoot has his first sleepover with Fox but misses his dad at bedtime.

BannerData.item_description: Meet Cody and the Helpsters, a team of vibrant monsters who love to solve problems. Whether it’s planning a party, climbing a mountain, or mastering a magic trick, the Helpsters can figure anything out—because everything starts with a plan.

Episodes.description: Percy is supposed to open his park to the public today—but it isn’t ready. Lizzy needs someone to watch Karen, her pet lizard.

Episodes.item_title: Bells and Whistles Will / Beatrice Builder
Episodes.description: Will loves to play hide and seek, but he always gets found first. Beatrice wants to learn how to build with sand.
Paul needs help turning his sheet music while he plays piano. Grandma Gracie and Cody’s regular lunch diner is closed.
Felix is going out of town on a hot day and can’t hand out freeze pops. Babette wants to go bowling but can’t find an alley.
Toni’s T-ball team needs another player for their game today. Todd lost the special trophy he made for the mayor—and now he must find it.
Delia receives a delivery request that seems impossible to fulfill. Niko wants to win a game of tag against Carla.

Episodes.item_title: Mail Carrier Marty / His Royal Primmness
Episodes.description: The Helpsters find out it’s Marty’s birthday while fixing his mailbag. Mother Primm announces it’s Mr. Primm’s turn to be King of Primmflandia.
Samantha wants to open a smoothie shop. Tina finds an ice cream cake in her taxi, but she’s not sure who it belongs to.

Episodes.item_title: Cheerleader Chadwick & Chelsea / Heart’s Family Dinner
Episodes.description: Chadwick and Chelsea need a new cheer to root for the Blue Team. Heart wants to spend more time with family.
Pietro promises his friends a pancake breakfast. Scatters volunteers his band for a concert even though he doesn’t have a band.

Episodes.item_title: Race Car Roxy / Helpsters Go to the Beach
Episodes.description: Roxy is racing in the Tiny Car Derby, but she’s only raced regular-sized cars. The Helpsters plan a fun day at the beach.

BannerData.item_description: Meet Pretzel, the world’s longest dachshund and a playful, supportive dad to five frisky puppies. Together with his wife, Greta, they encourage their pups to get their paws up to solve problems and “make their bark” on the world.

Episodes.description: New neighbor Gus keeps getting lost, so Poppy steps up to help. Pedro finds a way to get waggly Dill to sit still for his trim at Gigi’s Groom Palace.

Episodes.item_title: The Show Must Bark On / Dogs at Work
Episodes.description: Pippa creates new instruments for the band after theirs accidentally break. Poppy makes sure dogs of all sizes can access the new viewing tower.
Pedro helps create a traffic-free zone for scootering. The pups find a way to give their old toys new homes.

Episodes.item_title: Firedogs to the Rescue! / Pup-Up Playground
Episodes.description: Pedro inspires the city to thank the Muttgomery firedogs. Puck brings the fun to a pal whose neighborhood has no playground.
When a heavy snowfall jeopardizes the annual holiday festival, the pups find unique ways to celebrate with all the snowed-in dogs in the city.
Poppy’s cleanup mission inspires change in the neighborhood. Pedro sets out to retrieve a beloved ball from a nearby rooftop.
Pippa helps Rosie find a new way to style her bows. When Puck struggles to fall asleep, Pretzel invites him on a soothing journey.
Puck encourages Curly to face his fear of the local garbage truck. Paxton works on a special surprise for Nana Doxie.

Episodes.item_title: Pup Fiction / Night at the Pawspital
Episodes.description: Poppy leads a rainy-day trip to the Muttgomery Library. After Sammy hurts his paw, the pups cheer him up with a make-believe adventure.
Nana Doxie and her neighbors help Pedro master a scooter trick. Greta rallies the group for a hike to the snowy peak of Mount Muttgomery.
When Dill and Delilah’s hamster goes missing, the pups leap into action. Pedro discovers a unique way to meet dogs who want to play.

BannerData.item_description: Jack is one of Clover Grove’s most thoughtful and caring residents, greeting everyone with kindness and humor. His ability to spread compassion, creativity, and imagination inspires everyone in town to do the same.

Episodes.description: A minor injury leaves Chef unable to cook, so Jack steps in to keep the Friday Feast pizza tradition alive.
When Mr. Prickles reveals that he misses the garden at his old home, Jack and his friends work together to cheer him up.
Inspired by Jack, Cooper hands out paper hearts to brighten everyone’s day—and learns his kindness is the true gift.

Episodes.item_title: Jack and Olivia’s Big Bus Adventure
Episodes.description: Olivia’s nervous about her first time riding the bus, so Jack and his friends find creative ways to ease her fears.
Jack and his friends set out to solve a kindness mystery: Who’s behind the random acts of kindness popping up all over town?
When Olivia reveals she’s scared of spooky surprises, Jack leads the way as a trick-or-treating buddy.
Bebe’s big concert is threatened by a case of the hiccups, but Jack is determined to help her succeed.
At the Hummingbird Café, Jack finds a lost stuffie and looks for creative ways to care for it until its owner returns.
Olivia and Jack gallop around Clover Grove, encouraging their friends to believe they can do things they don’t think they can.
When Jack’s prized plant goes missing from the café, he and his friends try to find it by following a trail of clues.
After the town’s beloved gazebo is damaged, Jack and his neighbors team up to repair it.

BannerData.item_description: Doug is a young robot who senses there’s more to life than just the facts. While other robots plug in for their daily download, Doug unplugs and journeys into the human world with his best friend Emma to experience its wonders firsthand.

Episodes.item_title: Kicking and Botting / Bot on the Case
Episodes.description: Emma asks Doug if he and the other robots want to form a soccer team. Emma and Doug become detectives when a puzzle piece goes missing.
Doug and his family lose access to their technology while on a camping trip. Emma invites Doug and Uncle Forkrick to join her at the library.

Episodes.item_title: Like Botter, Like Son / Give It a Bot
Episodes.description: Joined by his dad and grandbot, Doug explores a small town while searching for a car part. Emma convinces the robots to play in the snow.

Episodes.item_title: Stop, Bot & Boogie / Bots in Show
Episodes.description: Emma invites Doug and the bots to her family’s annual dance party. Doug and Critter Bot participate in the Mega City Pet Show.

Episodes.item_title: Where No Bot Has Gone Before! / A Bot from the Heart
Episodes.description: Doug’s Aunt Rover comes to town and talks about her adventures in space. Doug and Bob Bot want to make Becky Bot’s builtday extra special.

Episodes.item_title: Bot to School / Bots at Play
Episodes.description: Doug joins Emma at school for the first time. Doug and the bots set out to make the perfect playground.

Episodes.item_title: When Life Gives You Bots / Bots of the Fall
Episodes.description: Emma and Doug get creative to help a neighbor share his lemonade. Doug and the bots discover what makes fall so special.
Doug and Emma put on a play with some surprising bot twists. A comic book inspires Emma and Doug to find their own superpowers.
Emma and Doug look for instruments so they can play in her mom’s band. Doug’s magic trick makes Critter Bot disappear...or does it?

Episodes.item_title: Bots on the Range / Brushin’ Bots
Episodes.description: Doug and Bob Bot head to a horse ranch for the ride of their lives. Emma needs Doug’s help to get her younger sisters to the dentist.
Emma meets a new bot who takes her and Doug on a deep-sea adventure. Will Doug and Jenny find the owner of a special photo album?

BannerData.item_description: Welcome to Long Hill Dairy Farm, home to Otis the tractor and all his friends. Otis may be little, but he has a big heart. Whenever he sees a friend in need, he hits the brakes to see what’s wrong and rolls into action to help.

Episodes.description: Kevin is worried about his first Tune-Up Day. Celeste the pig wants a quiet place to make up a new song.

Episodes.item_title: Otis Brings the Sheep Back / Daisy’s High High Jump
Episodes.description: Bringing the sheep back to the pen is harder than it looks. Daisy is ready to make her highest jump ever!

Episodes.item_title: Celeste’s Pumpkin Problem / Quest to Save the Nest
Episodes.description: The Biggest Pumpkin Contest is here, but Celeste’s pumpkin is at the top of a hill. Mama Bird needs a safe place for her nest.

Episodes.item_title: The Thankful Parade / Hay Day Hay Maze
Episodes.description: Otis and his friends celebrate the things they’re thankful for. Kevin, Elaine, and Sal explore a hay maze.
It’s Christmas Day and Rosalie is due to have her baby. Daisy wants to decorate the tree before her new sibling arrives.

Episodes.item_title: Sal Says / New Kids on the Farm
Episodes.description: Otis and Sal lead the chicks through a playful game. Goats Romie and Ralphie have trouble adjusting to their new home.

Episodes.item_title: The Sneaky Snacker / Celeste’s Barrel Adventure
Episodes.description: Sal and Otis search for answers when the chicken feed keeps disappearing. Otis and Daisy surprise Celeste by making changes to her barrel.

Episodes.item_title: A Picture for Louie / Otis Gets a Flat
Episodes.description: Otis tries to organize a group photo. The friends leap into action when Otis needs help during Farm Field Day.

Episodes.item_title: A Storm on the Farm / Daisy’s Sick Day
Episodes.description: Otis works to keep everyone safe during a storm. Sal and Otis try to cheer up Daisy when she feels sick.
Louie accidentally lets the pigs out. Daisy discovers her fear of heights during a dance party.

Episodes.item_title: Camp Chirp / The Hot Hot Day
Episodes.description: Sal and Otis lead a day camp for the baby birds. Otis, Sal, and Charles build the biggest slide ever.

BannerData.item_description: Cody is a helpful monster who knows that everything starts with a plan. But sometimes things change and you have to make a new one! Broadcasting from the Helpsters shop, Cody shares creative ideas for what to do when life doesn't go as expected.

Episodes.description: When Cody wants to visit her favorite tree but the park is closed, she makes a new plan.
There are many ways to be a Helpster, as Cody demonstrates—from dancing and singing to, most importantly, helping people.
Joined by her friend Amazing Alie, Cody shows us how to play games with our friends who are far away.
Cody loves giving people high-fives and handshakes—but what should she do when people aren't close enough to reach?
The Helpsters are used to being together in person. Now that they're apart, they make a new plan so they can still have fun with friends.
Cody is joined by special musical guests Grouplove for a song to thank everyone who's keeping us safe, happy, and healthy.

BannerData.item_description: Celebrate the merriest time of the year with the Peanuts gang. Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Linus, Lucy, and Sally each star in a collection of Christmastime tales from the original Peanuts comic strips.

Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn’t get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

sub_category_data.sub_title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne

BannerData.item_title: Snoopy Presents: For Auld Lang Syne
BannerData.item_description: After finding out her grandmother won’t be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year’s Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.

Lupita Nyong’o narrates a documentary about Peanuts and its creator, Charles M. Schulz. Famous fans—including Drew Barrymore, Kevin Smith, and Al Roker—share its influence on them, and a new animated story finds Charlie Brown on a quest.

Trailers.item_title: Who Are You, Charlie Brown? Trailer

BannerData.item_description: Peppermint Patty invites everyone to Charlie Brown's for Thanksgiving, even though he's going to see his grandmother. Snoopy decides to cook his own version of a Thanksgiving meal with help from his friends.

sub_category_data.sub_title: Peanuts in Space: Secrets of Apollo 10

BannerData.item_title: Peanuts in Space: Secrets of Apollo 10
BannerData.item_description: To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the moon landing, this documentary tries to solve the great mystery: Was Snoopy a top-secret astronaut? Starring Jeff Goldblum as a self-published NASA historian and Ron Howard as himself, Peanuts in Space takes an affectionate, lighthearted look at NASA and Charles M. Schulz’s beloved Peanuts characters.

The gang’s all here! Experience the nostalgia and joy of these iconic specials going back more than 50 years. Tag along with Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus, Lucy, and their pals for the early days of their antics and adventures.

Episodes.description: A 999-game losing streak has Charlie Brown’s baseball team wanting to quit—until he makes an exciting announcement. But there’s a catch.

Episodes.item_title: She’s a Good Skate, Charlie Brown
Episodes.description: Peppermint Patty trains for a figure skating competition with help from Snoopy. Marcie sews Peppermint Patty’s dress for the big day.
Charlie Brown would give anything to have a normal dog as Snoopy dances the night away and becomes incredibly popular for his smooth moves.
Charlie Brown decides to cheer up Snoopy by hosting a family reunion where life began for the beagles: Daisy Hill Farm.
Linus runs for student body president. Victory seems almost certain, until he makes a speech about the Great Pumpkin.
To celebrate Arbor Day, Charlie Brown’s baseball team turns the field into a lush garden, throwing Peppermint Patty off her game.

BannerData.item_description: The Peanuts gang is nervous about going to a new school, so Lucy starts her own. She soon learns that teaching is tougher than she thought—and that change can be a good thing.

The world’s most iconic dog is ready for his close-up. Dive into new adventures with the happy-dancing, high-flying, big-dreaming beagle, who’s joined by best friend Woodstock and the rest of the Peanuts gang.

Episodes.description: A newsletter gets the inside scoop on Charlie Brown; the gang learns to have fun from the cheap seats; and Spike invites Snoopy to the desert.
Sally takes care of Snoopy for the weekend; Charlie Brown quits the baseball team; and Peppermint Patty uses Snoopy as a stand-in.
Lucy hires Snoopy to protect her garden; Snoopy offers construction services to the neighborhood; and Snoopy’s old dog bowl is sorely missed.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness Is a Song in Your Heart
Episodes.description: Charlie Brown wants more attention from Snoopy; Sally’s class pet makes Snoopy jealous; and Lucy believes musicals cause nothing but trouble.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness is the Gift of Giving
Episodes.description: Snoopy adapts a Christmas poem to help Sally sleep; Charlie Brown makes gifts for his pals; and Snoopy can’t wait to open his presents.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness Is a Day at the Beach
Episodes.description: Snoopy and Woodstock search for pirate treasure; the Flying Ace steals Sally’s map; and Snoopy’s expired dog license presents opportunities.

Episodes.item_title: Happiness Is a Hug That Lasts
Episodes.description: Secret Agent Snoopy looks for Charlie Brown; the Beagle Scouts come to Woodstock’s aid; and a hug from Snoopy goes into overtime.
Snoopy and Marcie help Peppermint Patty with her report; Rerun mistakes Snoopy for a leprechaun; and Marcie’s quiet spot is discovered.
Lucy gives Snoopy a test; Spike and Snoopy forget to agree where to meet up; and Snoopy turns the tables on rejection letters.
Snoopy quits the baseball team; Peppermint Patty feels left out of Marcie and Snoopy’s playdate; and Snoopy fears a falling moon.

Episodes.item_title: Who Put the Beagle In Charge?
Episodes.description: Linus wants to thwart Snoopy’s blanket-stealing ways; Charlie Brown finally hits a home run; and Woodstock sends Snoopy a bill for a wild party.

sub_category_data.sub_title: It's the Small Things, Charlie Brown

BannerData.item_title: It's the Small Things, Charlie Brown
BannerData.item_description: Charlie Brown is determined to win the big baseball game. But things turn into a fiasco right before the matchup, when Sally bonds with a little flower on the pitcher’s mound and vows to protect it at all costs.

Quiet, kindhearted introvert Marcie has lots of brilliant ideas to help her friends achieve goals and solve problems. But when the world takes notice and the spotlight lands on her, sharing those ideas becomes a challenge.

sub_category_data.sub_title: Snoopy in Space: The Search for Life

BannerData.item_title: Snoopy in Space: The Search for Life
BannerData.item_description: Blast off with Snoopy as he takes on a new frontier: space! Joined by Charlie Brown, Woodstock, and the rest of the Peanuts gang, Snoopy embarks on epic adventures of interstellar exploration and discovery.

Episodes.description: Inspired by the neighborhood kids, Snoopy sets out to become a NASA astronaut.
Snoopy meets C.A.R.A. (NASA’s Computerized Astronaut Recruitment Advisor).
After his true identity is revealed, Snoopy must prove his worth to NASA.
Snoopy blasts off for the ISS and is surprised to see a familiar face on board.

Episodes.item_title: Mission 5: I Never Promised You a Space Garden
Episodes.description: Snoopy and Woodstock struggle to tend to the ISS garden.
A peaceful night on the ISS is interrupted when Snoopy realizes Woodstock’s missing.

BannerData.item_description: It's the night of Peppermint Patty’s New Year’s Eve bash, but Charlie Brown has to write a book report about War and Peace. Hoping to join the fun for a special dance with the Little Red-Haired Girl, he tries desperately to finish in time.

sub_category_data.sub_title: It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown

BannerData.item_title: It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
BannerData.item_description: Costumes, candy, this classic special—some things just scream Halloween. Join the Peanuts gang for a timeless adventure as Charlie Brown preps for a party, Snoopy sets his sights on the Red Baron, and Linus patiently awaits a pumpkin patch miracle.

Trailers.item_title: It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown Trailer

BannerData.item_description: Feeling down about the commercialism of Christmas, Charlie Brown becomes the director of the gang's holiday play. Can he overcome his friends’ preference for dancing over acting, find the “perfect” tree, and discover the true meaning of Christmas?

After discovering their troop is in danger of disbanding, Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts set off to the great outdoors to earn their badges. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown and friends enjoy their summer at Camp Spring Lake.

Episodes.item_title: A Beagle Scout Prepares / Teach a Bird to Fish
Episodes.description: Snoopy takes action after hearing his troop is at risk of being dissolved. The Beagle Scouts set out to earn their fishing badges.
Sally struggles to adjust to camp—but a new friend hops into her life. Charlie Brown enlists Snoopy’s help to deliver a special letter.

Episodes.item_title: To Dive or Not to Dive / Foul Weather Friends
Episodes.description: Peppermint Patty’s fear of diving sends her Snoopy’s way. The Beagle Scouts attempt to build a shelter as Sally and Naomi fight over bracelets.
Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts embark on a mission to earn their foraging badges. Charlie Brown is determined to win a “Piney” award.

Episodes.item_title: Campfire Yarns / Beagle Point or Bust
Episodes.description: The kids tell scary campfire stories, but Charlie Brown is lost for words. Snoopy’s journal sheds light on an ill-fated canoe voyage to Beagle Point.
Snoopy encounters a new nemesis: a mosquito that won’t leave him alone. Schroeder thinks the camp’s official song is due for an update.

BannerData.item_description: It's Valentine's Day and hearts are fluttering at school. Charlie Brown is waiting for his valentines to start rolling in, while Linus buys a present for his teacher Miss Othmar—which Sally mistakes as a gift from her Sweet Babboo.

As Christmas draws near, the Peanuts gang are in a tizzy as they prepare to celebrate. Charlie Brown needs money for his crush’s gift. Peppermint Patty’s worried about her book report. And the last thing Sally wants is to mess up her debut in the play.

Warm and fuzzy feelings fill the air as an inspired Snoopy writes poems about Valentine’s Day. Charlie Brown tries to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl. Sally and Lucy hope to get cards from their crushes. Peppermint Patty asks “Chuck” to the dance.

sub_category_data.sub_title: I Want A Dog For Christmas, Charlie Brown

BannerData.item_title: I Want A Dog For Christmas, Charlie Brown
BannerData.item_description: All Rerun wants from Santa is a dog, but his mother won’t let him have one. Spending time with Snoopy provides the perfect pick-me-up. But when Snoopy gets too busy to play with Rerun, they call in a substitute—Snoopy’s brother Spike.

sub_category_data.sub_title: It's the Small Things, Charlie Brown

BannerData.item_title: It's the Small Things, Charlie Brown
BannerData.item_description: Charlie Brown is determined to win the big baseball game. But things turn into a fiasco right before the matchup, when Sally bonds with a little flower on the pitcher’s mound and vows to protect it at all costs.

Between her parents’ divorce and best friend moving away, Amber Brown is having a tough time. But her art, video diary, and new friend Brandi provide outlets for Amber to express her feelings and find gratitude in the love that surrounds her.

Episodes.description: Starting middle school without her best friend, Justin, makes Amber all the more grateful for new friend and neighbor Brandi.
Amber and Brandi find a diamond ring, which leads Amber to believe her mom is about to do something Amber’s not quite ready for.
Amber sets aside her fears and auditions for the school play, while her dad moves into a new apartment.
It’s the night of the play and Amber’s nervous. She hopes her dad, who’s stuck in traffic, makes it in time to see her debut.
Amber wants to get her ears pierced—just like Brandi—so she enlists the help of Aunt Pam to try persuading her mom.
As the girls get ready for their first school dance, Amber feels bad about disobeying her mom and wants to come clean.

BannerData.item_description: Eleven-year-old Kevin’s passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure in this epic reimagining of the iconic film.

Episodes.description: A boy struggles to make the most of everyday life—until a bumbling gang of thieves lands in his bedroom.
On a whirlwind journey to ancient Mexico, Kevin and the Bandits take part in a feast. Pure Evil sends huntress Fianna on a quest.
The Bandits pose as dragon slayers in England and feel the wrath of a wicked sheriff. Saffron embarks on her own search for answers.
Kevin and the Bandits run for their lives during New York’s Harlem Renaissance. Saffron and an ally work to outwit enemies in Japan.
While searching for Kevin’s home, the Bandits cross paths with Casanova and the Earl of Sandwich. Penelope is challenged to a duel.
The Bandits scour the desert for a missing member and hatch a plan to rob history’s richest man. Widgit delves into the mysteries of the Map.

BannerData.item_description: Immersive audio reveals the unexpected, unfamiliar, and untold ways in which animals communicate around the world. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

Episodes.description: In ancient woodlands, a crocodile relies on sound to protect her babies, koalas release powerful roars, and an enchanting frog choir communes.
Mountains act as a huge echo chamber for elusive creatures—like snow leopards—who use the landscape to amplify their rarely heard love songs.
In one of the richest soundscapes, howler monkeys attempt to out-voice each other and sloths break their silence to search for mates.
Whale songs and dolphin clicks hold hidden meaning in an underwater world full of clever acoustic tricks.
Predators listen for frantic footsteps, cocktail ants craft a battle cry, and lions embrace the transformative power of rolling rain and thunder.
In subzero conditions, emperor penguins use custom calls to find their families. After dark, the northern lights make mesmerizing music.

BannerData.item_description: Franklin is new to town and hoping to make friends, but his usual tactics don’t work on the Peanuts gang. When the Soap Box Derby arrives, he’s sure it’s a chance to impress new pals and teams up with the only other unpartnered kid: Charlie Brown.

Iconic athletes pull back the curtain on a pivotal career moment when they touched greatness. A stylized hybrid of live action and visual effects, this short-form docuseries sheds new light on the sports legends you thought you knew.

Episodes.description: Morgan soared from bench player to starter on the U.S. Women’s National Team following a dominating performance.
The fastest man alive tells the story of the race that made him realize he was born to run.
White was already a superstar when a rocky performance at a 2018 Olympics qualifier left him rattled—and then propelled him to new heights.
An underdog teenager who just wanted to make the team, Ledecky achieved one of the most dominant Olympic performances in history.
His fifth world surfing championship was a spiritual odyssey that transformed Slater into a legend.
After a slew of injuries left the starting lineup short, Rashford rose to the occasion and made an unforgettable debut for Manchester United.
In a pivotal game against the Steelers, Wilson recorded a career-best passing performance—all while battling a flu that nearly sidelined him.
When skateboarder Bufoni won gold at the 2015 SLS World Championship, she proved her critics wrong and made history at the same time.
The 2017 World Para Athletics Championships were a cathartic step on a trying mental health journey for Bassett, a Paralympic sprinter.
In a historic moment at Talladega Superspeedway, Wallace became the first Black driver to win a NASCAR Cup Series in 60 years.
Vonn is one of the most decorated skiers of all time. And yet the greatest performance of her career didn’t end in victory.

BannerData.item_description: New school. New family. New superpower. It’s a season of change for 12-year-old Ben Vasani when he discovers that he can transform into anyone he meets. As a shapeshifter, Ben must figure out who he is and who he wants to be.

Episodes.description: Ben struggles to navigate major life changes when an encounter with a bully leads to a mysterious transformation.
Max and Ben start their search for answers. Darren embarks on his own investigation as secrets from his past begin to surface.
In trying to trigger his own abilities, Ben lands Max in a tricky spot and gives Carter reason to question Ben's choices.
Ben sets out to expose Jason while Darren’s determination sparks concern. Phil reveals a thoughtful surprise.
A covert mission takes shape on Max’s birthday. Meanwhile, the pressure to please her parents becomes a burden.
Hoping to better understand the past, Ben and Max visit Darren at home—and connect with a familiar stranger.

BannerData.item_description: Based on the treasured, classic book. When seven-year-old William receives a new favourite toy for Christmas, he discovers a lifelong friend and unlocks a world of magic.

In this animated musical comedy, Owen Tillerman and his family live an unconventional life in New York's bustling Central Park, which Owen manages. Now, they'll have to fend off a wealthy hotel heiress who wants to turn the park into condos.

Episodes.description: Owen and Paige set out to make the castle everything they dreamed it would be—if they can get the approval.
Owen’s mom derails a trip to the botanical garden when she makes a surprise visit. Paige chases a lead while writing a fluff piece on gifting suites.
After an embarrassing moment at school, Cole wants to change his name and identity. Owen, Paige, and Molly tell stories to help him cope.
In search of evidence for a story, Paige brings the family to a wake. Bitsy and Helen try to convince a big investor to join them in buying Central Park.
Season finale. Bitsy and Helen get stranded during a blizzard. The family finds out that the deal to sell Central Park is happening today.
The Tillerman family welcomes spring as an episode of a hit crime show films in the park.
As Paige prepares for a big meeting with a book publisher, she welcomes her sister Abby to New York City.
Molly and Brendan get into their first big fight, while Abby gets her first big commercial audition for a local deli.
Elwood forgets the password he created for the Tillermans’ hard drive, so the family must help him remember it or their memories will be erased.
In order to get his “I Heart the Park” campaign proposal approved, Owen has to repair old friendships at the Park Managers’ Conference.

Episodes.description: When the Tillermans visit Abby at her new job as waitress, a precious item goes missing—and everyone in the restaurant is a suspect.

BannerData.item_description: Quiet, kindhearted introvert Marcie has lots of brilliant ideas to help her friends achieve goals and solve problems. But when the world takes notice and the spotlight lands on her, sharing those ideas becomes a challenge.

The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.

Episodes.description: On a small island, a monumental display takes place as the giant Hatzegopteryx reveals his gentler side to woo a mate.
Trudging through a scorching desert, two young Tarchia find relief at an oasis and encounter an adult twice their size, ready to lay claim.
In a drought-stricken basin where much has perished, an old Pachycephalosaurus bull defends his leadership against a young challenger.
Deep beneath the water’s surface, the world’s largest predator—the Mosasaurus—lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting prey.
Not many can intimidate North America’s top predator, T. rex, whose size and bite are a deadly combo—except for a giant winged foe.
In a world covered in ice, woolly mammoths and saber-toothed cats fight to survive the coldest temperatures in millions of years.
As sea levels drop and continents shift, animals begin migrating to unknown territories full of new possibilities—and new threats.
With much of the planet’s water supply frozen, rock-climbing sloths and marsupial lions must find a way to withstand barren landscapes.
Giant herd animals thrive with the expansion of the grasslands, dominating the plains—but fearsome hunters shadow their every move.

BannerData.item_description: Travel from freezing poles to tropical rainforests to meet nature’s most captivating giants, who prove being big comes with enormous challenges. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

Episodes.description: Embarking on an epic journey for food, a mother whale leads her calf on the longest migration of any mammal.
A four-ton elephant seal returns to his breeding beach on the cusp of summer—and quickly learns the competition for females is fierce.
In the Brazilian Pantanal—a wetland larger than England—a six-foot otter attempts to raise her cubs in the shadow of hungry jaguars.
Makumba is one of the best studied gorillas in the world. Now past his prime, he must find new ways to maintain his status as king of the jungle.
In Earth’s largest inland delta, Africa’s deadliest mammal fights to keep his family afloat as the dry season approaches.
Rocky Mountain summers are fleeting, leading local bears to gain weight, sharpen defenses, and engage in a dynamic fight for domination.

BannerData.item_description: From Skydance Animation comes the story of Sam Greenfield, the unluckiest person in the world! Suddenly finding herself in the never-before-seen Land of Luck, she must unite with the magical creatures there to turn her luck around.

Warm and fuzzy feelings fill the air as an inspired Snoopy writes poems about Valentine’s Day. Charlie Brown tries to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl. Sally and Lucy hope to get cards from their crushes. Peppermint Patty asks “Chuck” to the dance.

In this sci-fi anthology series, curiosity leads to chaos when students in the near future experience mysterious events.

Episodes.description: Jacob is desperate to make the school track team and his height is holding him back. Can a medical research lab help him grow faster?
Aspiring dancer Jesse can’t balance his priorities, so a friend builds his robotic duplicate. But things take a turn when Jesse loses control of his double.

Carefree student Seth and his strict principal mistakenly swap bodies when a school presentation goes wrong.

Siblings Jack and Cassady buy a new remote for their media room and discover it can control their overbearing parents—for better and worse.

BannerData.item_description: After a life-changing experience, 13-year-old Ella is eager to seize the day. As she learns to appreciate each moment, she faces the fears that once defined her—and encourages others to do the same.

Episodes.description: A clean bill of health means a new beginning for Ella, but going back to school tests her can-do spirit.
As Ella encourages Kai to live in the moment, she attempts to let go of her past with Ximena. Grady discovers a new passion.
Ella searches for swimwear after being invited to a pool party. Grady makes a plan to step out of Ella’s shadow at school.
A flashback offers a glimpse into Ella’s interests—and anxieties—before everything changed. Grady and his dad search for a new shared hobby.
The McCaffreys embark on a spontaneous camping trip. Ximena and Kai put their friendship to the test at an escape room.
Ella gets the chance to meet her favorite pop star and tries to make the most of the opportunity.

BannerData.item_description: When a ghost haunts a neighborhood bookstore and starts releasing fictional characters into the real world, a group of friends team up to solve an exciting mystery surrounding the ghost’s unfinished business.

Episodes.description: Ruben’s lost in time. To get him back, Chevon, Curtis, and Donna need to decide if a pirate’s life is for them.
The kids are in a race against time to find the missing manuscript before Captain Vincent can get to it.
To solve a mystery involving famed private eye Owen Quinn, the kids must enter the book and become its characters.
A stolen art exhibit called The Cobalt Mask is found in Quinn’s office. The kids question his innocence.
The kids have a plan to save the bookstore, but it means finishing Mason Briggs’ last manuscript, which won’t be easy.
New friends Nia, Samir, and Charli meet a trio of Wizard of Oz-inspired characters and set out on a curious journey.
Oliver inspires a campus-wide search for answers. Nia struggles with a stranger’s accusation.
As Samir tries to connect with the characters, an adversary stirs up trouble. More of Oliver’s past comes to light.
Nia, Samir, and Charli cross paths with a young magician and learn about the Eloquent Peasant’s disappearance.
As Charli prepares for a big performance, the crew looks for clues from Oliver. Samir’s father opens up about his family history.

Episodes.item_title: The Ghost, the Mouse, and the Motorcycle, Part 1
Episodes.description: Oliver releases a tiny-but-mighty character to help the crew explore a secret tunnel. Nia meets a mentor and crafts a plan for change.

Episodes.description: Russ, Sky, Stanley, and Larry navigate a new crisis after Pandora is sucked into a work of art and surrounded by sinister spirits.
The Vanderhouvens travel to a stormy Scottish island and cross paths with a puzzling local. Larry and Stanley put their mapmaking skills to the test.
In order to get closer to saving Alex, the family must dig into the memories of Cornelius Vanderhouven.
Pandora, Russ, and Sky head to the jungles of the Yucatan in search of a powerful witch believed to be in possession of a protective amulet.

Episodes.item_title: The Ruby Hourglass & the Obsidian Sphere
Episodes.description: A major challenge pushes the Vanderhouvens to their limits. Can they overcome the impossible and finally bring Alex back?
The Vanderhouvens travel to Transylvania and dig deeper into a source of light with dark powers.
When a curse disrupts Pandora’s game night, a manticore crashes the party and presents a suite of risky challenges.
Larry leads a mission to honor the final request of an admiral—but his trusty crew faces chaos on the Aegean Sea.
The Vanderhouvens embark on an emergency trip to India when a menacing marionette takes control of Russ.

Episodes.item_title: The Inuit Glasses and the Peruvian Gourd
Episodes.description: Swirling, strange whispers cycle through the house as the Vanderhouvens search for a possible intruder.
The family head to New Mexico after an Old West artifact reignites a vengeful gang of cowboy spirits.

BannerData.item_description: In this short film from Skydance Animation, a horticulturalist-astronaut crashes onto a desolate planet. He encounters an ethereal visitor and discovers the joy of building a new life—realizing the universe has delivered something astonishing.

Outspoken and perpetually curious. That’s 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she’ll need to know everything. And to know everything means she’ll need to spy…on everyone.

Episodes.description: Janie and Harriet get to meet their favorite singer, only to discover a shocking truth about his music.
Harriet really wants to win a photo competition, but it means teaming up with someone she doesn’t see eye to eye with: her mom.
Sport and Harriet think it’s time to get rid of their beloved stuffies, but change their minds—and the narrative—thanks to Marion’s sneaky reporting.
Harriet adds the Garcia family to her spy route…and discovers that someone is spying on her.
On her birthday, Ole Golly revisits a list of everything she wanted to do by the age of 35—and Harriet is determined to help her complete it.
When Harriet loses her last—and favorite—baby tooth, she struggles with saying goodbye to her babyhood.

Episodes.item_title: It’s My Party and I’ll Spy If I Want To
Episodes.description: The Welsch family attends a neighborhood party where Harriet is determined to find out why the Robinsons are so boring.
At the world’s fair, Harriet meets a 14-year-old photographer who’s unsure of his future—but shows Harriet how to cherish today.
Sport joins Harriet for a local scavenger hunt. But when he brings his good-luck charm to improve their chances, Harriet is skeptical.
While Harriet’s parents are out, she and Ole Golly join Mr. Waldenstein for a movie date. But can they get home before Harriet’s parents do?
When Ole Golly announces she and Mr. Waldenstein are getting married and moving to Montreal, Harriet tries to change her mind.

Episodes.description: As summer kicks off, Sam and Jade's bond is tested, but a budding mystery brings them together for a twisting-and-turning mission.

Episodes.item_title: ...And the Untold Story of the Obsidian Flyer
Episodes.description: The Surfside girls learn what’s at stake if Danger Point collapses. In response, Sam goes hunting for ghosts and Jade conducts field research.
Sam, Jade, and Remi receive a new tip, but Sam struggles to balance the investigation and family time. Jade learns about the Lady of Surfside.
Grappling with guilt, Sam vows to make things right with her mom. Jade and Remi continue the search and uncover more about the secret cavern.
Sam and Jade search for missing evidence and realize Remi and Captain Devar may be able to help if they can recall forgotten memories.

Episodes.item_title: ...And the Day of the Flying Saucer
Episodes.description: The girls pivot from the supernatural to the scientific and make a surprising discovery, with help from Jade’s camp friends.

Episodes.description: An intruder attacks Sanctuary 573, forcing Eva above ground. Alone, she relies on her survival skills and a cryptic note labeled “WondLa”.
Eva discovers she’s on a planet called Orbona, where she meets a telepathic water bear named Otto and a surly alien named Rovender.
Determined to find other humans, Eva enlists Rovender’s help—but getting her first real lead comes at a high price.
Eva visits a sage and learns a grim fact about humans. Undeterred, she doubles down on her quest as Besteel the bounty hunter closes in.
Despite Muthr’s protests, Eva follows through on a daring plan and forms a friendship with an unlikely ally.
With a possible human civilization finally in sight, Eva and her friends face their most dangerous mission yet.

Episodes.description: Ben struggles to navigate major life changes when an encounter with a bully leads to a mysterious transformation.
Max and Ben start their search for answers. Darren embarks on his own investigation as secrets from his past begin to surface.
In trying to trigger his own abilities, Ben lands Max in a tricky spot and gives Carter reason to question Ben's choices.

A covert mission takes shape on Max’s birthday. Meanwhile, the pressure to please her parents becomes a burden.
Hoping to better understand the past, Ben and Max visit Darren at home—and connect with a familiar stranger.

Episodes.description: Inspired by the neighborhood kids, Snoopy sets out to become a NASA astronaut.
Snoopy meets C.A.R.A. (NASA’s Computerized Astronaut Recruitment Advisor).
After his true identity is revealed, Snoopy must prove his worth to NASA.
Snoopy blasts off for the ISS and is surprised to see a familiar face on board.

Episodes.item_title: Mission 5: I Never Promised You a Space Garden
Episodes.description: Snoopy and Woodstock struggle to tend to the ISS garden.
A peaceful night on the ISS is interrupted when Snoopy realizes Woodstock’s missing.

BannerData.item_description: After discovering their troop is in danger of disbanding, Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts set off to the great outdoors to earn their badges. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown and friends enjoy their summer at Camp Spring Lake.

Episodes.item_title: A Beagle Scout Prepares / Teach a Bird to Fish
Episodes.description: Snoopy takes action after hearing his troop is at risk of being dissolved. The Beagle Scouts set out to earn their fishing badges.
Sally struggles to adjust to camp—but a new friend hops into her life. Charlie Brown enlists Snoopy’s help to deliver a special letter.

Episodes.item_title: To Dive or Not to Dive / Foul Weather Friends
Episodes.description: Peppermint Patty’s fear of diving sends her Snoopy’s way. The Beagle Scouts attempt to build a shelter as Sally and Naomi fight over bracelets.
Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts embark on a mission to earn their foraging badges. Charlie Brown is determined to win a “Piney” award.

Episodes.item_title: Campfire Yarns / Beagle Point or Bust
Episodes.description: The kids tell scary campfire stories, but Charlie Brown is lost for words. Snoopy’s journal sheds light on an ill-fated canoe voyage to Beagle Point.
Snoopy encounters a new nemesis: a mosquito that won’t leave him alone. Schroeder thinks the camp’s official song is due for an update.

Episodes.item_title: Triangle Goes Solo / Circle Makes a Mistake
Episodes.description: The fearless Triangle sets out on his own. Circle leads a journey to ancient ruins and unexpectedly runs into trouble.
A change of plans tests Square’s patience. Circle helps Square start a garden, but she struggles with his instant success.

Episodes.item_title: Triangle and Square’s Big Game / The Shooting Star
Episodes.description: When Circle brushes off their game, Triangle and Square feel insecure. A mysterious meteor crash inspires a trek across the island.
After Triangle pranks them, Circle and Square celebrate Halloween on their own with all treats and no tricks.
The chilly season leaves Square feeling sad, so Circle and Triangle try to cheer him up by creating a new holiday: Yeti Night.

Episodes.item_title: Narrator’s Big Day / Square’s Time Chest
Episodes.description: The Shapes’ rather ordinary day gives Narrator time to herself. Square struggles to find the perfect object for his time capsule.
Square feels guilty after trading away a gift from Circle. Square and Circle try to find the source of Triangle’s allergies.

Episodes.item_title: Square’s Missing Mug / Triangle Stands Still
Episodes.description: The disappearance of Square’s favorite mug sends him on an island-wide hunt. Triangle bets Circle that he can meditate for 10 minutes.
Circle wakes up to a surprise—and suddenly needs a place to stay. A new visitor to the island creates quite a stir.

Episodes.item_title: From Top to Bottom / Circle’s Equal
Episodes.description: Circle, Square, and Triangle face off in a wild race for a tasty prize. Circle is thrilled to finally meet a Shape like her.
Triangle and Square follow a mysterious map, hoping to find treasure. Circle’s hat design inspires her to make bigger, better creations.

Charles agrees to foster an adorable but high-maintenance Yorkie pup. Lizzie gets paired with the school’s judo champ for an assignment.

Lizzie’s Caring Paws Club comes up with an idea that’s just what Charles needs to help a misunderstood rottweiler puppy.
